descricao.en-US: 3D tic-tac-toe on a 4×4×4 cube against the AI, line up four in any direction.
descricao.es-ES: Tres en raya 3D en un cubo 4×4×4 contra la IA, alinea cuatro en cualquier dirección.
descricao.fr-FR: Morpion 3D sur un cube 4×4×4 contre l’IA, alignez quatre pions dans n’importe quelle direction.
descricao.de-DE: 3D-Tic-Tac-Toe auf einem 4×4×4-Würfel gegen die KI, bringe vier in beliebiger Richtung in eine Reihe.
descricao.ja-JP: 4×4×4のキューブでAIと対戦する3D三目並べ, どの方向でも4つ揃えよう。
descricao.zh-CN: 在 4×4×4 立方体上与 AI 对战的 3D 井字棋 —— 在任意方向连成四子。

descricao.ru-RU: Крестики-нолики 3D на кубе 4×4×4 против ИИ, соберите четыре в ряд в любом направлении.
descricao.ar-AR: إكس-أو ثلاثي الأبعاد على مكعب 4×4×4 ضد الذكاء الاصطناعي, رتّب أربعة في صف بأي اتجاه.

pt-BR.resumo: Jogo da velha 3D grátis no navegador: cubo 4×4×4 contra a IA, alinhe quatro em qualquer direção do espaço.
pt-BR.sobre: A velha num cubo de 4×4×4: valem as linhas dos planos, as colunas em profundidade e as diagonais que atravessam o cubo inteiro. São 76 linhas vencedoras, e é por isso que o empate quase não existe aqui.
pt-BR.comoJogar: Gire o cubo com o mouse e clique na casa. A IA joga em seguida, e ela olha as diagonais.

en-US.resumo: Free 3D tic-tac-toe in your browser: a 4×4×4 cube against the AI, line up four in any direction in space.
en-US.sobre: Tic-tac-toe on a 4×4×4 cube: plane lines count, depth columns count, and so do the diagonals that cross the whole cube. There are 76 winning lines, which is why draws barely happen here.
en-US.comoJogar: Rotate the cube with the mouse and click a cell. The AI answers, and it does watch the diagonals.
